title: CRM Sales Opportunities Dashboard
summary: Pipeline and win-rate analysis of CRM sales opportunities.
problem: Analyze sales pipeline performance, identify bottlenecks in opportunity conversion stages, and evaluate sales representative win rates across multiple product categories.
datasetInfo: CRM transactions and opportunity tracking dataset containing 10,000+ records with stage histories, deal values, timestamps, and representative assignments.
cleaning: Normalized date fields, handled missing deal closure values, removed duplicate opportunity IDs, and validated foreign key references between sales reps and accounts.
analysis: Calculated conversion velocities through pipeline stages, cohort win-rate metrics, and discount sensitivity curves using SQL aggregations and Python Pandas.
sqlAnalysis: Authored multi-table CTEs to compute rolling quarterly revenue attainment, stage progression duration, and representative benchmark rankings.
insights: Identified a 28% drop-off between Proposal and Negotiation stages, with highest win rates concentrated in mid-tier enterprise package offerings.
recommendations: Implement automated stage-gate qualification criteria for early-stage leads and focus sales enablement on negotiation phase objection handling.

title: Coffee Shop Sales Dashboard
summary: Sales trends by product, store and hour for a coffee chain.
problem: Examine hourly customer demand patterns, store revenue disparities, and product mix profitability to optimize staffing and inventory across retail locations.
datasetInfo: Point-of-sale transactional log spanning 6 months across 3 distinct store locations, encompassing product categories, transaction amounts, and timestamps.
cleaning: Cleaned transaction timestamps, standardized product categorization, resolved outlier unit prices, and merged store dimension metadata.
analysis: Conducted time-series hourly order volume analysis, product affinity grouping, and revenue per square foot comparisons in Power BI and SQL.
sqlAnalysis: Leveraged window functions (ROW_NUMBER, LAG) to analyze peak hour transactions, customer basket sizes, and day-over-day sales velocity.
insights: Peak volume occurs between 8:00 AM - 10:30 AM driven by specialty espresso beverages; afternoon hours showed high bakery product attachment rates.
recommendations: Reallocate barista shift schedules to front-load staffing during morning peak hours and introduce an afternoon beverage-and-pastry combo promotion.

title: UK Railway Analytics
summary: Delay and revenue patterns across UK rail journeys.
problem: Assess punctuality performance, delay causes, and passenger revenue distributions across major UK rail routes to support operational reliability reviews.
datasetInfo: National railway journey records detailing origin/destination stations, scheduled vs. actual departure/arrival times, delay reasons, and ticket class types.
cleaning: Engineered calculated columns for delay minutes, categorized weather and mechanical delay flags, and filtered cancelled vs. rerouted services.
analysis: Analyzed route reliability correlations, seasonal weather impact on track delays, and passenger refund liability metrics using Python and Tableau.
sqlAnalysis: Executed SQL queries grouping delays by operator, corridor, and time of day, computing on-time performance percentage KPIs.
insights: Weather-related disruptions accounted for 42% of significant delays (>30 mins) during winter quarters, heavily concentrated along northern coastal segments.
recommendations: Deploy targeted preventive track maintenance schedules ahead of peak adverse weather seasons and optimize passenger communication for delay compensations.

title: Home Price Analysis
summary: Drivers of home prices explored with Pandas.
problem: Determine key structural, geographical, and demographic attributes influencing residential property valuations to guide investment screening.
datasetInfo: Residential property sales dataset featuring 80+ explanatory variables describing property features, square footage, neighborhood ratings, and sale prices.
cleaning: Imputed missing values using median/mode distributions, applied log transformations to normalize skewed price variables, and encoded categorical neighborhood indicators.
analysis: Exploratory data analysis utilizing Pandas and Seaborn to compute feature correlation heatmaps, price-per-square-foot ratios, and outlier detection.
sqlAnalysis: Queried historical price deciles, year-over-year neighborhood growth rates, and bedroom-to-bath ratio pricing premiums.
insights: Overall quality score and above-ground living area exhibited the strongest correlation with final sale price (r > 0.75), while lot frontage showed minimal impact.
recommendations: Prioritize property renovations focusing on kitchen finish quality and interior living space expansion over exterior lot alterations to maximize resale ROI.
